skill.name: workflow
skill.description: Coordinates PM and implementation handoffs, completion reports, and approved review issue fixes for Claude-based workflows.
skill.summary: Creates structured handoffs, completion reports, and reviewed fix workflows for PM and implementation roles.
skill.author: Chachamaru127

content.value_statement: Two-agent development can lose context during handoffs and review fixes. This skill creates structured handoff messages, completion reports, and approved auto-fix workflows.
actual_capabilities: Routes requests to auto-fix, PM-to-implementation handoff, or implementation-to-PM report instructions.
Generates PM-to-implementation task briefs with background, acceptance criteria, scope, targets, and constraints.
Generates implementation completion reports with changes, tests, acceptance status, risks, and next actions.
Guides review issue remediation through review loading, fix identification, preview, user approval, and reporting.
Provides Japanese trigger phrases and metadata for manual workflow activation.
limitations: It provides process instructions, not an autonomous project management system.
Auto-fix changes still require user approval before edits are applied.
It depends on project artifacts such as Plans.md, review results, git status, and git diff.
It does not replace the separate 2agent skill for full two-agent setup.

use_cases.title: Prepare Implementation Briefs
use_cases.description: Create a clear task request with context, scope, acceptance criteria, and constraints for another implementation session.

use_cases.title: Report Completed Work
use_cases.description: Summarize implementation results, changed files, tests, remaining risks, and recommended next actions.

use_cases.title: Apply Review Fixes
use_cases.description: Turn review findings into scoped fixes, preview the changes, and generate a short fix report.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Handoff
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a handoff request for the implementation role. Use the current task context and include acceptance criteria.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a simple PM-to-implementation task brief.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Scoped Request
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a PM-to-implementation handoff for this task. Include background, expected outcome, scope, non-goals, likely files, and constraints.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request when the implementation scope needs clear boundaries.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Completion Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Write a completion report for PM review. Include summary, changed files, tests performed, acceptance criteria status, risks, and next actions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request after implementation work is finished.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Approved Review Fixes
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the latest review findings, identify fixable issues, preview the proposed changes, and wait for approval before editing.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for controlled remediation of review comments.

output_examples.input: The PM wants to hand off a feature task to the implementation role.
output_examples.output: A structured task brief with background, expected result, acceptance criteria, scope, target files, and constraints.

output_examples.input: The implementation role finished the assigned task.
output_examples.output: A completion report with summary, changes, changed files, tests, acceptance status, risks, and next action options.

output_examples.input: A code review found issues that should be fixed.
output_examples.output: A controlled fix plan that identifies remediable issues, previews edits, requests approval, and reports completed changes.

best_practices: Provide the current task, desired outcome, and acceptance criteria before asking for a handoff.
Review generated handoffs and reports before pasting them into another agent session.
Approve only fixes that match the review findings and project scope.
anti_patterns: Using this skill to configure a full two-agent setup.
Applying auto-fix changes without reviewing the proposed edits.
Creating handoffs without current plan, diff, or review context.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps create PM handoffs, implementation completion reports, and approved review fix workflows.

faq.question: Does it run a full two-agent system?
faq.answer: No. It routes workflow documents and notes that full two-agent setup belongs to a separate 2agent skill.

faq.question: Can it edit code automatically?
faq.answer: It can guide auto-fix work, but the documented flow requires a preview and user approval before edits.

faq.question: Which languages does it support?
faq.answer: The skill documentation uses English metadata and Japanese workflow instructions and trigger phrases.

faq.question: What project context should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the active task, plan notes, review findings, changed files, tests, and any important constraints.

faq.question: Is it useful outside Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. It provides structured workflow prompts that can also guide Codex and Claude sessions.
